Name: Perfumed Candles
Author: Ex0dus
Description:
[size=4][b]Description:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b] [/b][/size]
[size=3]My wife and I already enjoy Murmur of Bees and Perfumery by HarrisonGrey but she wanted more things to do with the perfumes from the Perfumery (and also was sad that romantic perfume was the least valuable) so I made this mod. [/size]

[size=3]This mod adds a machine (the Candle Station) that unlocks at Farming level 7. The Candle Station turns perfumes from the perfumery into candles using beeswax. Beeswax is made (in the cooking menu) from honeycombs produced by beehives in Murmur of Bees.[/size]

[size=3]A version for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30597]Bees Plus[/url] can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/games/stardewvalley/mods/52795/]here[/url] [/size]


[size=4][b]Main features:[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3]Configurable amount of beeswax made when cooking honeycombs in the cooking menu[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]5 candles that correspond to the 5 types of perfume made by the Perfumery mod[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Candle prices increase when the special order added by the Perfumery mod is completed[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]More valuable perfumes do not necessarily make the most profitable candles (though all candles are profitable). This gives lesser perfumes some later game use.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Candle Rankings:[/b][/size]
[spoiler][size=3]1. Romantic
2. Mystic
3. Cozy
4. Brisk
5. Rustic[/size][/spoiler]

[size=4][b]Future Plans:[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3]Specific Gift Tastes[/size][/*]
[*]Crossover items with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49743]Chocobo Valley Remixed[/url] [/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]

[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37426]Murmur of Bees[/url][/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36832]Perfumery[/url][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][b][size=4]Installation Instructions:[/size][/b]

[size=3]Download the Perfumed Candles file in the main files section, then install like normal

Be sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37426]Murmur of Bees[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36832]Perfumery[/url] and their requirements installed first, otherwise this mod will do nothing.[/size][/color]
